title: Jesse Stavro's Compass
author: Arlan Wetherminster
description: This abandoned desert motel had a name once. But the travelers who pass through here now call it Buridan's Bridge. It is a cluster of Doors; portals to anywhere so long as you have the right Key. You've been here two days waiting for the next thing to happen, whatever that may be. You are looking for your friend Jesse Stavro. He came through here recently. You're not far behind him now.
